title: Macrocephalopod - Managing a Mid-Frequency Crypto Prop Desk (S6E5)

reader_summary.headline: A word of mouth is how this podcast grows.
reader_summary.overview: A word of mouth is how this podcast grows. In this episode, I speak with the anonymous Twitter user macrocephalapot. The arc of our conversation follows the arc of his career. A large part of the conversation can be characterized as comparing and contrasting the roles through the lenses of research, operations, and risk management.

key_points.text: The arc of our conversation follows the arc of his career.
key_points.evidence_quote: The arc of our conversation follows the arc of his career, beginning with slow frequency style premium in a hedge fund to building a prop desk that trades mid-to-high frequency strategies in crypto.

key_points.text: For example, in what ways is long-short equity meaningfully different than long-short crypto?
key_points.evidence_quote: For example, in what ways is long-short equity meaningfully different than long-short crypto?

key_points.text: Or, how important are topics like market impact, fill ratios, and borrow fails in mid-versus-slow-frequency strategies?
key_points.evidence_quote: Or, how important are topics like market impact, fill ratios, and borrow fails in mid-versus-slow-frequency strategies?

key_points.text: While crypto is the venue, I believe the wisdom imparted in this episode spans all markets.
